'''Jshain''', officially the '''Federal Republic of Jshain''', is a country in [[Southern Acrola]]. It borders the [[Diairesi Sea]] to the west, [[Hkuqo]] to the north, [[Jau]] (via the [[Quadpoint]]), [[Taniduna]] to the east, and [[Taoisia]] to the south. Jshain's capital city is [[Savyan]], and the largest city is officially [[Savyan]], but both [[Jidet]] and [[Dulravi]] claim to be the largest.

Jshain has been inhabited since prehistoric times by the [[Etolic peoples|Etolic]]. Around the 1st century, [[wikipedia:immigration|immigrating]] [[Shrewa peoples]] arrived as part of the [[Shrewa expansion]], while at the same time, the Passonians began settling the coast, forming local city-states. During the [[Second City-state period]], the area encompassing modern-day Jshain remained fractured. The [[Alqiran Empire]] ended this period with the conquest of the coasts of the [[Diairesi Sea]] in the 9th century. After the Kaastini conquests, the area was left nearly depopulated, with all major cities and settlements destroyed. During the 14th century, the [[Sivosoan Empire]] ruled most of the former city-states of Jshain. In 1476, the predecessor Kingdom of Soutan was formed, encompassing most of modern Jshain. The [[Emaran Empire]] established rule over most of the territory, forming a colony known as [[Emaran Haiza]]. After the Great Imperial War, the colony was expanded to include the modern nation of Haiza.

During the decades after the Red War, Jshain fought for its independence, with uprisings and demands for political representation resulting in Jshain declaring an independence war against Haiza in 1712, gaining independence in October 1714. After Haiza's withdrawal, the nation plunged into civil war, ending in 1732, with the defeat of the Unionists in the highlands near the Tanidunan border. However, the [[Daascat Islands]] remained under Haizan control until 1744.

Jshain is a [[parliamentary democracy]]. Agriculture, [[Tourism in Jshain|tourism]] and the [[Mining in Jshain|mining industry]] - including mining for nickel, form the basis of its [[Economy of Jshain|economy]], while the manufacturing sector is comparatively small. Despite significant [[wikipedia:Gross domestic product|GDP]] growth since its independence, [[Poverty in Jshain|poverty]] and [[Wealth inequality|inequality]] remain significant. 41% of the population is affected by [[wikipedia:Multidimensional Poverty Index|multidimensional poverty]], and more than 1,000,000 people live in [[wikipedia:informal housing|informal housing]]. 

With a population of 12.5 million people, it remains densely inhabited along the flat portions near the coast, with the inland areas very sparsely populated. Since the 1740s, it has attracted notable immigration from Taval, Hkuqo, and Taniduna. Jshain is a member state of the [[Global Trade Union]] and the [[South Acrolan Cooperation Council]].
